attestations.note: The life page `https://www.saint.gr/2532/saint.aspx` heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 24 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps for the Romanian church, and the company is the same three. The page says they were from Asia, were arrested by idolaters because they were Christians, and were dragged over sharp stones until they died, and that their relics were brought from Asia to Thasos, where they are to this day. It gives no year and no emperor, so no `dates` object is proposed, and no coordinate for Asia or Thasos. No hymn; no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (24 September 2026).
